description: Compare LiFePO4 and NMC lithium-ion power stations on cycle life, safety, weight, cold charging and price so you pick the right chemistry for camping.
directAnswer: LiFePO4 is usually the better pick for a power station you will use for years, with roughly 2,000 to 6,000 cycles and better thermal stability. NMC lithium-ion is lighter and cheaper upfront, so it suits occasional trips and hike-in use.
